tasks.title: Modify project-id.ts
tasks.description:
MODIFY src/domain/project-id.ts. Add `computeLegacyProjectIds` alongside canonical `computeProjectId`. Tests: src/domain/project-id.test.ts

REVIEW FAIL (code): Legacy Git identity after adding origin — FR-001 (Project enrollment and legacy aliases).
  WHERE: src/domain/project-id.ts:27-46
  EXPECTED: Enrollment preserves the prior project ID for a Git checkout that adds an origin. Legacy IDs include MD5("local:" + dirname(gitCommonDir)) when the checkout used that key.
  ACTUAL: For projectRoot "/tmp/repo" and gitCommonDir "/tmp/repo/.git", computeProjectId without origin returns "7a4d53c5949e77c3fa2a1d25a817b1a1". After adding origin, computeLegacyProjectIds returns only "dc2190bb335e0fe3f07577e9e7629c89" and "9e9b22f1cb0d873507139f227aa7d4e2". The existing ledger ID is absent.
  FIX: Derive the prior local ID from the Git common directory when available and keep both path aliases. Update the enrollment contract to include that alias. Ensure enrollment supplies gitCommonDir after origin is set. Add a regression that finds the pre-origin ID in the post-origin aliases.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T001, gate: gates/phase-01.sh, re-opened by review):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/domain/project-id.ts — Keep both path hashes in `computeLegacyProjectIds` and append `MD5("local:" + path.dirname(gitCommonDir))` when `gitCommonDir` exists. In `src/adapters/git/project-id.ts`, always read the absolute Git common directory in `discoverGitIdentityFacts`, including after origin is set. Update `specs/048-project-identity-slack/contracts/project-registry-and-storage.md` to list all three aliases. Add a regression in `src/domain/project-id.test.ts` that adds origin to a temporary Git checkout and asserts the post-origin aliases contain the pre-origin ID and both path hashes. Verify the regression fails before the fix and passes through `specs/048-project-identity-slack/gates/phase-01.sh`.
FIX: src/domain/slack-routing.ts — Retain the required stored-thread check in `evaluateSlackAction` for `merge_pr`. Require the selected project, feature, workspace, channel and `threadTs ?? messageTs` to match. Keep the existing top-level null and missing binding cases in `src/domain/slack-routing.test.ts` asserting `THREAD_PROJECT_MISMATCH`.
FIX: src/domain/slack-routing.ts — Retain `selectProject(candidates, requestedProject)` in `evaluateSlackRoute`. Use `workspaceProjects.some` only after a selector miss to distinguish `CHANNEL_PROJECT_MISMATCH` from `UNKNOWN_PROJECT`. Keep the existing foreign-workspace collision and denial tests in `src/domain/slack-routing.test.ts` asserting that `alpha` resolves locally and `beta` returns `UNKNOWN_PROJECT` without `candidateSlugs`.
FIX: src/domain/slack-routing.ts — Retain the stored-thread check for `view_review` and `view_logs`. Set `recipient.threadTs` from `storedThread.rootTs` only after the binding matches. Keep the existing viewer tests in `src/domain/slack-routing.test.ts` for both unbound denial and bound success.
FIX: src/domain/slack-routing.ts — Preserve `THREAD_PROJECT_MISMATCH` when a merge payload names a different project from the stored binding in an eligible conversation. Check the mismatch before returning a payload lookup miss. Preserve `UNBOUND_WORKSPACE` and `UNBOUND_CHANNEL`. Keep the existing foreign payload regressions in `src/domain/slack-routing.test.ts`.
FIX: src/domain/slack-routing.ts — In `evaluateSlackAction`, resolve a supplied `payloadProjectId` by exact `projectId` among eligible conversation projects. If `requestedProject` is also present, require `matchesProjectSelector` to match that same project or return `THREAD_PROJECT_MISMATCH`. Preserve thread validation, role authorization and replay denial. In `src/domain/slack-routing.test.ts`, add a shared-channel maintainer `merge_pr` case with a second enrollment whose slug equals `PROJECT_ALPHA.projectId`. Assert the click selects Alpha and a conflicting explicit selector returns `THREAD_PROJECT_MISMATCH`. Verify the collision case fails before the fix and passes through `specs/048-project-identity-slack/gates/phase-01.sh`.

Verification at 0cdca366: the Git fixture adds an origin and checks that the legacy local Git identity and both checkout path aliases survive.

  ACTUAL: With storedThread: null and threadTs omitted, rootTs equals messageTs. A maintainer click for an unbound feature returns ok: true and assigns that message as the recipient thread.
  FIX: Require a matching stored binding before authorizing a feature-thread mutation. Add a top-level merge click test with no stored thread.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Workspace-scoped project selection — FR-002 (Slack workspace, channel and role authorization).
  WHERE: src/domain/slack-routing.ts:208-242

  ACTUAL: selectProject(projects, requestedProject) checks the global registry before checking candidates. A foreign workspace alias matching the local alpha slug returns AMBIGUOUS_PROJECT_SELECTION with candidateSlugs [alpha, beta].
  FIX: Resolve selectors against conversation candidates before computing ambiguity. Return a generic denial for out-of-scope matches and cover a foreign-workspace alias collision.

  FIX: Require a matching stored binding before returning a feature reply recipient. Add a regression test for an unbound top-level view_review click and a success case for a bound review click.

  FIX: Check the payload against the stored binding before returning a selector miss for an otherwise bound conversation. Keep workspace and channel checks. Add a regression test for a foreign-workspace project ID on a bound thread.
